buyer_persona.name: Rosalind Achterberg
buyer_persona.role: Head of operations for a group of 11 care homes and 4 outpatient clinics
priorities: Stop losing mornings to last-minute sick calls
Cut agency spend on unfilled shifts
Keep every shift at safe staffing levels
Get the rota out of spreadsheets without retraining everyone
objections: What does this cost per staff member per month, including onboarding?
Which care groups like ours already use it? I want to speak to a reference.
Are you ISO 27001 or HITRUST certified? Our IT and data protection leads will ask.
Half my carers have old phones. Will the app actually work for them?
What happens on a Sunday night if your system goes down and I need to cover a shift?
language: agency staff cost us a fortune
the rota lives in a spreadsheet
